anchor: v1::Grace Odhiambo, ORD-20768. The leather hiking boots are half a size too small. Can I exchange them?

result.text: Yes, you can exchange them at no cost. I've started the return for your leather hiking boots (return ID RMA-20768) under the wrong-size reason. Once the return is scanned, the replacement in the size you need can ship, so please place a new order for the correct size. If you'd rather not exchange, the return also qualifies for a full $159 refund within 5–7 business days of the boots reaching the warehouse.

results.title: Exchanges
results.body: Footwear and apparel can be exchanged for a different size or color within 30 days of delivery at no cost. To exchange, start a return with reason "wrong_size" and place a new order; the replacement ships once the return is scanned.
